name: Dock-TS-TW

frames.best_why: One icon is fully magnified with its 'Inbox' name tag above, while its neighbour is also growing.

tagline: Icons swell as the pointer passes and name tags float above.
summary: A dark rounded bar holds six round icon buttons. Sliding the pointer along it grows the nearest icons and lifts a small name tag above the one under the cursor.
appearance: A long dark bar with a grey outline sits low on the stage, holding six evenly spaced circular buttons, each with a white line icon. When active, a tiny rounded name tag floats above the bar.
behaviour: Moving the pointer across the bar makes the closest icons swell and nudges their neighbours wider. The icon under the pointer shows a label overhead, and all return to even size when the pointer leaves.
demo_content: Six icons for home, archive, mail, music, user and settings, labelled Home, Archive, Inbox, Music, Profile and Settings.
search_phrases: app launcher at the bottom of the screen
floating icons that zoom on approach
use_when: An app or desktop-like screen wants a compact launcher bar that stays out of the content.
avoid_when: Magnification assumes a mouse; on touch screens icons never grow and labels need a tap.
customise: Pass the items array of icon, label and click handler plus bar height, icon size, magnification, distance and spring as props; the dark colours are hardcoded.
weight_why: Six icon springs that only move while the pointer is over the bar.

a11y.note: Icons are tabbable with a role and a hover label, but Enter and Space never fire the click and no focus ring is drawn.

issues: The bar has no visible focus ring, and Enter or Space does not activate a focused icon.
polish_why: Convincing magnification and tidy outlined icons; labels are tiny and the bar itself is plain.
